reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-10-27 re-read of the Solstice attestation API reports its latest aggregate timeline point dated 2026-10-21: reserves $205,978,791.53 against outstanding USX $203,405,511.13 (collateralization 1.012651, overcollateralized and delta-neutral flags true, verifiability 100). The API still publishes no category or instrument weights and no separate report period end or publication date, so the timeline date is used for both, as for the prior 2026-09-23 point. The live Solstice attestation adapter owns the aggregate reserve row; the unresolved 100% basket and all adverse uncertainty remain unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Solstice collateral disclosure and the 2026-10-21 aggregate reserve-versus-supply attestation read from the Solstice attestation API on 2026-10-27; no category weights published
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current split among audited cash, tokenized Treasuries, and delta-neutral hedged positions is not published; underlying instruments, custodian shares, execution venues, and hedge counterparties are also undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Solstice names three broad reserve categories, but the aggregate attestation does not establish current category or instrument weights.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Solstice names Copper and Ceffu as third-party custodians and the May 2026 whitepaper states that off-chain reserves sit at regulated custodians under segregated account structures, but the issuer does not publish current custodian shares, identify hedge venues, or establish legal bankruptcy remoteness or rehypothecation terms for the complete reserve.
